name: Plinth

adaptedFrom.name: AstroPaper
reused: Type first page architecture: a wordmark header with a short navigation, a heading and standfirst block, a dated list of entries and a rule bounded footer
The dated entry list with tag pills (src/components/Card.astro, Datetime.astro, Tag.astro), rebuilt as the programme entry blocks
The CSS custom-property token approach (src/styles/theme.css and global.css), rewritten as the :root token set in style.css
The skip link and the single-column reading measure discipline (src/components/Header.astro, Main.astro)
notReused: Astro, Tailwind, pagefind and the npm toolchain
The light and dark theme switcher, the search page, pagination, RSS and the OG image generator
All AstroPaper copy, blog content, screenshots and social images
Every image file in the upstream repository

photography: None. This edition contains no photographs, no generated images and no assets taken from any reference site. Every graphic is an SVG file written by hand; the diagonal section rules are CSS gradients.

fonts.origin: @fontsource-variable/inter, latin subset with the weight axis, copied from public/templates/_plotform-fonts

referenceDirection: A contemporary art institution read as typography and geometry: an oversized lowercase wordmark, a twelve column grid whose entries step across it, exhibition entries as typographic blocks with dates and rooms, flat colour fields in paper, ink and vermilion, and a drawn floor plan. No reference site code, imagery or branding copied.
demoContent: Plinth, its rooms, programme, works, address and opening hours are illustrative examples, not a real institution. No prices, visitor numbers, awards, sponsors or testimonials appear anywhere.
